<issue>
Support DataValidation on `ComboBox`'s `TextProperty` when `IsEditable`
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

Unlike for example TextBox here: https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/blob/master/src/Avalonia.Controls/TextBox.cs#L154

ComboBox doesn't `enableDataValidation` in it's property definition: https://github.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/blob/master/src/Avalonia.Controls/ComboBox.cs#L88

There doesn't appear to be a trivial way to opt-in for this validation without either ending up forcing a different usage pattern, either with an AttachedProperty or derived control, or by using some hack-ish reflection.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Would it make sense for validation to be enabled for this property?

In the case that it doesn't, what would be the rationale behind it?

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### Additional context

_No response_

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed/src/Avalonia.Controls/ComboBox.cs, show the definition of TextProperty and how it's declared (AvaloniaProperty.Register<ComboBox,...>), plus any code referencing TextProperty / IsEditable / UpdateDataValidation. Also show how TextBox.cs declares TextProperty with enableDataValidation and overrides UpdateDataValidation.
